messages:
Tess (Support): Escalating MediCore onboarding -> private deployment provisioning blocked by missing compliance artifacts; legal review hold. Customer is in regulated space, pilot converting to paid in 3 weeks. @Rina can you own comms and overall plan? :rotating_light:
Rina (CS): Ack. Need scope: what's missing, who owns docs, estimated unblock time, and a comms plan. @Nora heads up for account outreach.
Samir (Solutions): Samir here 1: the infra side needs signed DPA + SOC2 AOC or a completed security questionnaire to provision VPC. Tess paste the ticket link + exact missing items.
Tess (Support): Ticket #92321 details: customer provided SOC2 report but missing AOC (attestation of control) and the signed DPA. Upload folder link: https://redwood.docs/medi-core-92321. Error in provisioning: "compliance: missing_aoc".
Asha (Security): Confirmed. We haven't received AOC or completed questionnaire. Legal needs customer signature on DPA before we can enable Private. Asha: can fast-track security review once docs are in.
Nora (Account): I'll own customer comms. Comms plan proposal: 1) immediate ack + clear list of missing docs 2) offer help (template AOC request + DPA signing link) 3) temporary workaround: hosted sandbox while we finalize private deploy 4) weekly sync until provisioned. Owner for comms = Nora, CS owner = Rina, tech = Samir. Renewal_flag=true until provisioned.
Rina (CS): Good. Also include offer for a short 30m compliance walkthrough with our Security + Legal to reduce friction. Add escalation to sales leadership if customer expresses pricing/contract concerns.
Samir (Solutions): Tech plan: once DPA signed and AOC is uploaded, infra can provision a private environment in ~36-48h (resource scheduling dependent). I'll reserve a slot with infra but need legal sign-off to proceed.
legal-bot: Templates: DPA signing link -> https://contracts.redwood/dpa-template; AOC request template -> https://redwood.docs/templates/aoc-request.md
Tess (Support): Sent checklist to customer at 09:12 with links and offered the hosted sandbox. Customer responded: "We can sign DPA today but AOC requires internal audit, expect 5-7 business days." They asked if hosted sandbox is acceptable for pilot continuation.
Nora (Account): Drafted customer response: "Thanks. We can accept signed DPA to begin onboarding into hosted sandbox immediately; we'll coordinate a compliance walkthrough to help collect the AOC faster. We'll keep private deployment scheduled and notify you when AOC arrives." Sending now.
Asha (Security): Offer: we can provide a guided AOC template and a 1-hour assisted audit session with our compliance SME which might speed internal audit to 2-3 days. I'll schedule if customer agrees.
Rina (CS): Updated comms plan: 1) Nora send ack + sandbox offer (sent) 2) Asha offer assisted audit (pending customer) 3) Samir pre-book infra slot and stand by for DPA signature and AOC upload 4) Rina schedule weekly check-ins. Jordan set renewal_flag=true until AOC uploaded.
Samir (Solutions): Infra slot reserved for earliest provisioning 2026-10-12 08:00 UTC. If AOC arrives earlier we can provision earlier. I'll prepare an activation checklist and runbook for handoff.
Tess (Support): Customer accepted DPA signing today at 10:05 and requested assisted audit. Also accepted hosted sandbox to continue pilot. Updating ticket #92321.
Nora (Account): Sent assisted audit invite for 10/09, included Asha and our compliance SME. Also confirmed hosted sandbox provisioning ETA ~2 hours.
Asha (Security): Confirmed assisted audit session booked. Provided AOC template + examples in the invite.
Rina (CS): Follow-ups: Nora to confirm DPA signed + attach signed DPA to ticket; Asha to run assisted audit; Samir to provision hosted sandbox now and switch to private once AOC uploaded; Rina to track renewal flag and postmortem after provisioning.
Samir (Solutions): Sandbox provisioned at 12:40. Customer onboarded sandbox users. Monitoring for any feature gaps.
Tess (Support): Ticket updated: DPA signed and attached at 13:05. Customer informed of assisted audit on 10/09.
Nora (Account): After audit session, customer said internal team can produce AOC within 3 business days. They appreciate the assisted session. Recording as feedback: our AOC templates and assisted audits are high impact.
Asha (Security): Received AOC upload at 2026-10-14T11:20 UTC. Performing final check.
Samir (Solutions): Asha confirmed AOC valid. Starting private provisioning at 11:45. Expected handoff to CS and account in ~48h.
Rina (CS): Great. Renewal_flag cleared: de-escalated. Final action items: Samir to confirm private env activation and IP allowlist update; Nora send post-provision summary and success note; Rina to capture lessons learned and update onboarding checklist (owner Rina, ETA 5 business days).
Tess (Support): Ticket #92321 closed and linked to this thread. Thanks team. :tada:
